name: sprintboard
description: SprintBoard - a project management and issue tracking app (React + Express + PostgreSQL)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n postgres,server,client -c blue,green,magenta "npm run postgres" "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.db:setup: node server/scripts/postgres.js ensure && npm run setup --prefix server
scripts.db:reset: node server/scripts/postgres.js ensure && npm run reset --prefix server
scripts.test: node server/scripts/postgres.js ensure && npm test --prefix server
